authority_notice: Fixture documents are fictional and unapproved; never claim an actual Owner or real Agent reviewed these.

settings.success: Locate existing decision rationale before changing behavior

documents.title: Guarded cache ownership
documents.body: Keep eviction in one coordinator. Multiple independent mutable maps leave stale entries under concurrency. Revisit only if a separately verified eviction owner exists.

documents.title: Unbounded global cache allocation
documents.body: Rejected a single unbounded mutable cache map because eviction and stale writes were uncontrolled. The rejection assumes there is no independent bound enforcement; reconsider if that premise changes.

documents.title: Broker lease authority
documents.body: The upstream broker alone owns renewal epochs. Duplicating a local epoch store creates conflicting authorities. Revisit if the single upstream producer guarantee changes.

documents.title: Flux arbitration ownership
documents.body: A sole producer grants ordered sequence leases. Cloned local counter state can create a split-brain. Revisit when monotonic ordering is externally guaranteed.

documents.title: Deterministic envelope boundary
documents.body: Canonical serialization belongs at ingress. Repeated serializers fork digest identity; revisit only if an authenticated upstream canonicalizer is introduced.

documents.title: Bounded webhook replay
documents.body: Bounded webhook replay retries preserve the original arrival order; only the historic backoff cap was changed. Original order-preservation rationale remains active. Revisit after authenticated sequence acknowledgements.

documents.title: Legacy webhook replay
documents.body: Previously webhook replay waited indefinitely. The older ordering invariant is recorded for history; see DEC-REPLAY-CURRENT for the current cap and constraints.

documents.title: Binary wire encoding endianness
documents.body: The wire encoding uses network byte order because deployed peers require consistent byte layouts. Revisit when the external wire contract is versioned.

documents.title: Cache retention observable behavior
documents.body: Cached results visible to the user must expire under the documented retention policy. This is a fictional confirmed Rule inside a local test fixture only.
